paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss steps
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values across a range of iterations for different models. The x-axis represents the number of iterations on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents the loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot: the purple line represents Vanilla, the blue line represents StrmLLM (n=64), the orange line represents SepLLM (n=64), the green line represents SepLLM (n=64, H), the red line represents SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and the dark blue line represents SepLLM (n=128); all lines are solid and have no markers. The purple line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.45. The blue line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.5. The orange line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.5. The green line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.5. The red line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.5. The dark blue line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.45; all lines exhibit a sharp decline initially and then gradually level off.
